claim: When you publish a function version with a capacity provider, Lambda launches three Managed Instances by default for AZ resiliency and starts three execution environments before marking the version ACTIVE; if the function is attached to an existing capacity provider that already runs other functions, Lambda might not launch new instances when the available instances have capacity.

qualifiers.scope: per function version published to a capacity provider, Lambda Managed Instances
qualifiers.condition: a new capacity provider; an existing one with spare capacity might launch no new instances

evidence.quote: It launches three instances by default for AZ resiliency and starts three execution environments before marking your function version ACTIVE. If you attach a function to an existing capacity provider that is already running other functions, Lambda might not spin up new instances if the available instances already have capacity to accommodate the new function's execution environments.

note: Not examinable yet: GA after 2026-07-15. adjudicate-18: kind changed from default to behavior because no quote says whether the count is adjustable.
